name: Golden Dream! Formalwear Set
come_from: Available at the Gift of Stardust store
desc: An outfit for the conductor. They can change into it using Pom-Pom's Coatroom in the Party Car.
lore: The finest attire Pom-Pom wears on formal occasions. Forged from the galaxy's most advanced craftsmanship, every stitch and thread radiates dazzling, opulent gold, clearly reserved for only the grandest of celebrations.
